categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hongxin Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of forged aluminum alloy wheels for automobiles. Its product portfolio includes forged aluminum wheels for commercial vehicles (such as medium and heavy trucks, buses, and new energy buses) and passenger vehicles (including new energy vehicles, pickups, high-end passenger cars, and automotive aftermarket). The company also produces other forged products like forged wire reels and wheel accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in forged aluminum alloy wheel technology, which offers advantages over traditional casting methods such as energy savings, environmental protection, lighter weight, higher strength, and better plasticity. It has developed advanced forging processes, including digital production lines, four-stroke forging, machining process optimization, automated surface treatment, and nanomaterial surface protection (Magshine). The company also applies innovative surface finishing techniques like polishing, coating, PVD, and heat spray technology to enhance durability and aesthetics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) such as Haomet, Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor, Shaanxi Heavy Truck, BYD, and CRRC Times, as well as overseas clients like Rivian, Lucid, and Paccar in the United States. The company serves both the automotive aftermarket and OEM supply chains, with partnerships with brands like WheelPros, AmericanWheels, Jost, KalTire, S.M.Heights, and Weds. The markets served span commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Taizhou, Zhejiang Province. It has expanded internationally with a wholly-owned subsidiary in Thailand (Allotek Co., Ltd.) and sales networks covering the United States, Europe, Australia, Canada, Japan, and South Korea. The Thailand production base began trial production in March 2025 and is expected to enhance overseas capacity and market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Hongxin Technology operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of forged aluminum alloy wheels. It supplies directly to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, as well as to the automotive aftermarket, positioning itself as a key component supplier within the automotive manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation in forging processes, lightweight materials, and surface treatments to enhance product performance and competitiveness. R&D efforts focus on digitalized production lines, forging precision, automated manufacturing, fatigue testing equipment, and new multi-piece welded wheel designs. It also emphasizes expanding production capacity, including the Thailand base, and strengthening its global market position, especially in the new energy vehicle segment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of forged aluminum alloy wheels and related products. The company recognizes revenue at the point of delivery and customer acceptance, including domestic and export sales. It also earns income from selling scrap aluminum and receives government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the early domestic pioneers in forging aluminum alloy wheels in China, successfully breaking foreign brand monopolies in the commercial vehicle segment. It holds a competitive position with strong R&D capabilities, quality certifications (IATF16949, DOT, VIA, CWIC, SMITHERS, FRAUNHOFER, INMETRO), and a growing international footprint. Competitors include other domestic and international aluminum wheel manufacturers, especially those using casting technologies, but Hongxin emphasizes forging technology and lightweight solutions as differentiators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.028 billion, a 6.95% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 50.13 million, a 31.28% decrease mainly due to rising raw material costs and increased expenses. Total assets grew 44.28% to RMB 1.618 billion, and net assets increased 75.15% to RMB 776.82 million. The company expanded production capacity from two to four plants and invested heavily in the Thailand base, indicating a growth trajectory with ongoing capital expenditures and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes the superior performance of forged aluminum alloy wheels, including lightweight design for fuel efficiency, excellent heat dissipation, high precision and durability, and aesthetic appeal with diverse surface treatments. Its forging technology offers higher strength and safety compared to cast wheels, supporting automotive lightweighting trends and new energy vehicle requirements. The company also highlights its strong R&D, quality management, and international certifications as key differentiators that provide customers with reliable, high-quality, and innovative wheel solutions.
